capabilities: Carry variables and functions down a note

disambiguation: Not a LaTeX or math-rendering plugin; it evaluates arithmetic typed on ordinary note lines.
extras: Plain-English questions need the separate Tahoe Intelligence plugin and a Mac; everything else works offline with no accounts, telemetry or payments. Part of the Tahoe plugin family.
intentEvidence: Numerals and Tahoe Math both use math.js, and both work on phones and tablets.
problem: Doing arithmetic inside a note normally needs a code block or an outside calculator, and the result has to be copied back by hand.
